candidates.name: Cherubism
support_spans: progressive, bilateral, painless swelling of the jaws
symmetrical enlargement of the mandible and maxilla
well-defined, multilocular radiolucent areas involving the mandibular bodies, angles, ascending rami, and the maxillary tuberosities
candidates.why: The symptoms and radiographic findings are consistent with Cherubism, a rare genetic disorder characterized by bilateral swelling of the jaws.
